006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
009
010/**
011 * Indicates a constraint validation failure.
012 */
013public class ConstraintValidationException
014    extends Exception {
015
016  /**
017   * the serial version UID.
018   */
019  private static final long serialVersionUID = 2L;
020
021  /**
022   * Constructs a new exception with the specified detail message. The cause is
023   * not initialized, and may subsequently be initialized by a call to
024   * {@link #initCause}.
025   *
026   * @param message
027   *          the detail message, which is saved for later retrieval by the
028   *          {@link #getMessage()} method.
029   */
030  public ConstraintValidationException(@Nullable String message) {
031    super(message);
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Constructs a new exception with the specified cause.
036   * <p>
037   * If the cause has a detail message (i.e.
038   * {@code (cause==null ? null : cause.toString())} then the message provided by
039   * the cause will be used.
040   * <p>
041   * This constructor is useful for when this exception is raised as a wrapper of
042   * another exception.
043   *
044   * @param cause
045   *          the cause (which is saved for later retrieval by the
046   *          {@link #getCause()} method). A {@code null} value is permitted, and
047   *          indicates that the cause is nonexistent or unknown.
048   */
049  public ConstraintValidationException(@Nullable Throwable cause) {
050    super(cause);
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Constructs a new exception with the specified detail message and cause.
055   * <p>
056   * Note that the detail message associated with {@code cause} is <i>not</i>
057   * automatically incorporated in this exception's detail message.
058   *
059   * @param message
060   *          the detail message, which is saved for later retrieval by the
061   *          {@link #getMessage()} method.
062   * @param cause
063   *          the cause (which is saved for later retrieval by the
064   *          {@link #getCause()} method). A {@code null} value is permitted, and
065   *          indicates that the cause is nonexistent or unknown.
066   */
067  public ConstraintValidationException(@Nullable String message, @Nullable Throwable cause) {
068    super(message, cause);
069  }
070}
